messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed steady KV cache memory growth on canary after the kernelexec changes. Long-ctx sessions seem to retain large prefix entries even across different requests. Anyone else see this? (runtime: canary-3)
ryan: I saw similar in perf run today. Might be key fingerprinting change; we moved from sha1 to xxhash64 and accidentally dropped tenant salt in some paths.
sanjay: if tenant salt missing then prefix keys collide -> fragmentation + higher residency. Can you paste a sample key? Also what eviction policy are we using? LRU with periodic compaction?
maria: example key (sanitized): `kv:pref:xxh:0x7af3c6:session:abcd...` — looks like duplicates with different session IDs but same prefix hash.
dana: fyi profiling shows longer-scoped KV refs after kernel reorder — GC sweep runs lessfrequently. sample from perf trace:
```
KV residency: 23MB -> 98MB over 15m
evict_calls/sec: 0.2 -> 0.05
fragmentation_score: 0.68
```
perf-bot: [alert] memory_leak_detected on canary-3, trace_id=tr-9c3b. Top hotspots: kv_store::insert, kernel::batch_step
ryan: if salt dropped, we should normalize keys to include tenant and route before hashing. quick patch I sketched:
`key = format!("{}|{}|{}", tenant_id, route_id, prefix); hashed = xxhash64(key)`
sanjay: also suggest adding `prefix_cohort` tagging so eviction can prefer cross-tenant shared prefixes for time-windowed TTL.
maria: can we have a short mitigation — disable cross-session prefix reuse via `sticky_prefix = false` flag for canary? Then rerun perf for 1h.
dana: +1. That will reduce reuse but will confirm if reuse was causing memory bleed. we'll accept slight token cost.
ryan: i'll push config toggle to canary-3 now and run microbenchmark (cmd below)
```
./tools/kv_bench --mode=prefix-reuse --concurrency=200 --duration=600 --trace
```
sanjay: i'll run a compaction job after the toggle: `./tools/kv_compact --shards=all --max-age=30m`
maria: thanks. please post results here. if we confirm, we should revert kernel reorder or ensure salted hashing + periodic compaction. :thumbsup:
ryan: noted — will report by EOD. @dana @sanjay please ping if you see regression.
